description: The store: master data models kept in your own SQL Server or PostgreSQL databases, with validated writes, history and audit, over a management API a console pairs with. Needs the .NET 10 runtime (ASP.NET Core).
notes: The server's state, certificate and models live in the server's data directory, away from the program files. The state database is a SQLite file in that directory; to put it in a database shared by a group or the install run: dbdatastore state init. Start it with: dbdatastore server run. Pair a console with it: dbdatastore server pair --max-role admin. A model's own tables are made on a SQL Server or PostgreSQL connection of the server's, not on SQLite.
